scope: CPU-only inspection of two completed real native single-thalamus fits; NPZ/images remain remote
interpretation: Synthetic input/output arrays and cost histories are bitwise identical in this two-run real case. The unchanged intensity stages still differ by 110 native output voxels. This candidate has lower official weighted Dice than both C6 and the regressed run and is retained only as diagnostic evidence.
evaluation_status: C3 restores bitwise repeatability of synthetic inputs/output meshes and objective histories in this case but does not recover official fine-label Dice; not selected for final full-pipeline benchmark.
